quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration (customers not named): two customers accounted for 55% and 45% of total revenue in 2025 (86% and 14% in 2024). Net sales were $236,855 in 2025 versus $95,605 in 2024, all generated outside the United States in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: two customers 55% and 45% of 2025 revenue; net sales $236,855

quarterly_data.signal: Commercial agreements (10-K): commercial operations, begun in May 2023, consist of a material supply license agreement to provide Perkinamine chromophore materials, granting a non-exclusive, royalty-bearing license with Lightwave supplying the polymers. A memorandum of agreement with a customer for joint development of electro-optic polymer modulators on silicon photonics was executed in January 2026 (work began in 2025), and the 10-K also describes a December 2025 memorandum of agreement (joint development agreement) with other parties to develop an electro-optic polymer-based modulator chip, covering a multi-project wafer chip at a mutually agreed foundry, post-processing, product verification and volume-manufacturing preparation. The Design Win Cycle typically spans approximately 18 to 24 months; back-end-of-line polymer deposition is currently performed in Englewood, Colorado and is expected to be transferred to foundry partners as programs move toward volume production.
quarterly_data.figure: Design Win Cycle approximately 18 to 24 months
